adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in the admin-group.js.es6 controller, both `addMembers` (line 64) and `removeMember` (line 56) call methods on the model that return promises, but these promises are not handled - no `.then()` or `.catch()` is chained. Looking at the model in group.js, both `addMembers` and `removeMember` return Discourse.ajax promises. If these AJAX calls fail, there's no error handling at the controller level to notify the administrator. The `removeMember` action does return the bootbox.confirm result but doesn't chain error handling on the model call. The `addMembers` action doesn't return anything and has no error handling. This is a real defect where failed operations would silently fail without user feedback.
